p1.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/07/evalworksus5.ballys.electricity_redacted.pdf
p1.excerpt: A description of plans for procuring or generating on-site at least 10 percent of the facility’s annual electricity consumption from renewable energy sources qualified by the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA).

p2.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/07/evalworksus5.ballys.electricity_redacted.pdf
p2.excerpt: In addition to on-site generation, the remainder of the renewable energy needed to meet at least 10 percent of the facility’s annual electricity consumption will be procured from renewable energy sources qualified by the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA).

p3.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/07/evalworksus5.ballys.electricity_redacted.pdf
p3.excerpt: To reduce electrical demand and comply with New York City local laws, the resort plans to install photovoltaic (PV) solar panels across the parking garage and select roof areas in accordance with NYC Local Laws 92 and 94. Approximately 46,000-sq. ft. will be utilized for photovoltaic panels and associated inverters. These areas are predicted to produce approximately 1.8 million kWh of carbon free electricity per year.

p4.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/07/evalworksus5.ballys.electricity_redacted.pdf
p4.excerpt: The target is approximately 6% of the annual energy consumption.

p5.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/07/evalworksus5.ballys.electricity_redacted.pdf
p5.excerpt: As the Gaming Facility’s design is finalized, the exact proportions of energy generated on-site versus energy procured will be further refined to ensure the target of at least 10 percent renewable energy consumption is met.

p6.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/ballys-new-york-casino-workforce-enhancement-sustainable-development-principals-energy-consumption
p6.excerpt: Use of Renewable Energy Credits (RECs): To offset any residual emissions, Bally’s will purchase RECs in accordance with LL97 guidelines.

p7.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/gaming-facility-location-board-final-report-and-findings-march-2026
p7.excerpt: Four applicants - Bally's Bronx, Hard Rock Metropolitan Park, MGM Yonkers, and Resorts World New York City - received Community Advisory Committee approval, establishing public support for these projects. The other four applicants failed to achieve the required two-thirds approval threshold and were eliminated from further consideration.

p8.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/ballys-bronx-application-materials
p8.excerpt: As of May 5, 2026, the following Bally's records denoted with “REVISED REDACTIONS” suffixes have undergone the statutory review process, are considered final, and are posted below.

p9.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/07/evalworksus5.ballys.electricity_redacted.pdf
p9.excerpt: Bronx Bally’s will also embrace NYSERDA Tier IV NYC centric renewable energy with the goal to increase the penetration of renewable energy in New York City through eligible resources located in NYC or delivered through a new transmission interconnection to NYC.

p10.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/ballys-new-york-casino-workforce-enhancement-sustainable-development-principals-energy-consumption
p10.excerpt: On-Site Solar Generation: Rooftop and canopy-mounted photovoltaic (PV) systems will be installed to generate clean electricity, with battery storage to manage peak loads and provide backup power.
